t.name: Hayden Pass Trail
t.description: This trail connects the Elwha River Trail to the Dosewallips River Trail via Hayden Pass.

t.name: Lost Pass Trail
t.description: This steep trail climbs from Dose Meadows up to Lost Pass where it connects to the Cameron Creek Trail.

t.name: Dosewallips River Trail
t.description: The trail follows the main fork of the Dosewallips River from the Dose Ranger Station to Hayden Pass.

t.name: Upper Gray Wolf River Trail
t.description: The trail climbs from the park boundary along the Gray Wolf River to Gray Wolf Pass.

t.name: Gray Wolf Pass Trail
t.description: Thiis trail climbs from the Dosewallips River Trail up to Gray Wolf Pass.
